en: The image is a vintage black and white photograph showing a large group of dancers performing a traditional dance in coordinated formation, watched by onlookers. The dancers are wearing traditional Burmese attire, including sarongs and jewelry. Musicians sit on the side, playing traditional instruments. In the background, there are distinct structures that appear to be stupas or pagodas, contributing a religious or ceremonial setting. The postcard bears captions on the front and side, indicating the subject and publisher.
